newsitem.title: GERMANY: CS First Boston keeps Mannesmann as buy.
newsitem.headline: CS First Boston keeps Mannesmann as buy.

text.p: CS First Boston said on Wednesday it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Mannesmann AG, and said the group should gain above-average benefit from Germany's expected economic upturn.
"We believe the weak cycle in German engineering markets has now plateau-ed and is about to turn," the bank said in a statement.
"As an engineering concern with a high level of operational gearing, Mannesmann is set to benefit disproportionately from any upswing," the statement added.
The bank also cited Mannesmann's strong position in telecommunications as a positive factor.
CS First Boston's earnings per share forecast for Mannesmann in 1997 is 32 marks. The forecast for 1996 is 21 marks.
